title: RunReport v1
description: Canonical JSON schema for the AI Software Factory RunReport contract v1.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the factory run.

attempt_id.description: Unique identifier for the execution attempt.

base_commit.description: Git commit SHA-1 at task start (40 hex chars).

head_commit.description: Git commit SHA-1 at task completion (40 hex chars).

outcome.description: Final outcome of the task execution.

worker_id.description: Identifier of the worker that executed the task.

diff_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the diff between base_commit and head_commit.

gate_snapshot_id.description: Validation snapshot identifier if gates were run.

artifact_refs.description: Relative paths to persisted artifacts for this run.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the report was created.
